semantics.capture: Accepted named File I/O and named project download requests; exact immutable original bytes and metadata; optional background capture failure does not undo artwork
semantics.retention: Shared SHA256 payloads; atomic entry/blob/eviction/GC transactions; malformed entries remain visible and block overwriting
semantics.invalidation: Durable removal generation captured before hash and checked in commit; notifications are advisory, not required for stale rejection
semantics.reopen: Verified independent File; raster native-size new document at revision/history zero; project and SVG/TIFF/Photoshop retain existing validation/preflight
semantics.search: Open session IDs plus valid recent IDs; selected identity preserved or requires explicit new navigation
semantics.privileges: Trusted browser only; no isolated script/plugin/REST file or session synchronization grant
